# Practice audit: every question

<!-- Generated by scripts/canonical-audit.gen.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 114 questions that existed before the rebuild keep their ids, exercise formats and case-study membership; 25 new questions were added for weak areas. When a slug changed because it named retired data, the old slug still resolves to the same question (and its page’s canonical link points to the new slug). **MIGRATE** keeps the skill and wording intent on a canonical dataset; **REWRITE** keeps the id but replaces the task because the old one only made sense on the retired fixture; **NEW** is a new question. No question was retired.

Decisions: MIGRATE 52, REWRITE 62, NEW 25. Formats: Write SQL 111, Predict Output 14, Debug Query 14.

Every reference solution and authored equivalent passes through the production request path; every listed wrong approach is valid SQL that fails grading; every Debug starter fails; and the changed-data fixture changes every Write/Debug answer (`tests/canonical/practice.test.ts`, `tests/canonical/engine-features.test.ts`). Ten of the trickiest answers are also recomputed independently in TypeScript from raw rows (`tests/canonical/anchors.test.ts`).
